# This wiki has moved

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The Currencyinfo wiki is **deprecated** and is no longer updated. The maintained documentation lives at **<https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im>**.
>
> It is version-controlled in the [`docs/`](https://github.com/Adamant-im/currencyinfo/tree/master/docs) directory of the repository, so it is reviewed with the code it documents and corrected in the same pull request.

This page is kept so that existing links keep working.

## Where everything went

| You were looking for | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Installation | [Installation](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/guide/installation) and [Quick start with Docker](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/guide/quick-start) |
| API documentation | [REST API reference](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/reference/api) |
| Saved rates format | [Rate history](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/guide/history) |
| Notifications | [Notifications](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/guide/notifications) |
| Dealing with rate differences | [Rate calculation](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/guide/rate-calculation) |
| Rate life time | [Freshness](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/guide/rate-calculation#freshness-ratelifetime) |
| Contributing | [Contributing](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/project/contributing) |
| Migration from v4.0.0 or v3.x.x | [Upgrade and rollback](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/guide/upgrading) |
| Every configuration option | [Configuration reference](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/reference/configuration) |
| Rate sources, quotas, and terms | [Rate sources](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/reference/sources/) |

The complete mapping, including what was corrected during the migration, is published at [Documentation map](https://currencyinfo.docs.adamant.im/project/documentation-map).
